en.sayed-ali-raza: so that he may take out His people from the worship of idols towards His worship and from obeying Satan towards obeying Him
and sent him with the Qur’ān which He explained and made strong,

in order that the people may know their sustainer (Allāh) since they were ignorant of Him, may acknowledge Him since they were denying Him, and accept Him since they were refusing (to believe in) Him.
Because He, the Glorified, revealed Himself to them through His Book without their having seen Him,
by means of what He showed them out of His might and made them fear His sway.
How He destroyed those whom He wished to destroy through His chastisement and ruined those whom He wished to ruin through His retribution !
